programs.01c89e481b9a2ec851f3b49feb32f22ad2d12e69:
(rule!
  (let* ((occupancy (lambda (row) (count-where (lambda (v) (!= v 0)) row)))
         (anchor (first (sort g (lambda (a b) (> (occupancy a) (occupancy b))))))
         (colors (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0)) anchor)))
         (target (first (sort colors
                   (lambda (a b)
                     (> (count-where (lambda (v) (= v a)) anchor)
                        (count-where (lambda (v) (= v b)) anchor)))))))
    (sort g (lambda (a b)
              (> (count-where (lambda (v) (= v target)) a)
                 (count-where (lambda (v) (= v target)) b))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (freq values color) (count-if (lambda (v) (= v color)) values))
  (define (occ values) (count-if (lambda (v) (!= v 0)) values))
  (define (dom values) (apply max (map (lambda (c) (freq values c)) (range 1 10))))
  (define (diversity values) (count-if (lambda (c) (> (freq values c) 0)) (range 1 10)))
  (define (mode values start) (first (sort (range start 10) (lambda (a b) (> (freq values a) (freq values b))))))
  (define (key<? a b) (cond ((empty? a) #f) ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
    ((> (first a) (first b)) #f) (else (key<? (rest a) (rest b)))))
  (define indices (range (rows g)))
  (define occupancy-order (sort indices (lambda (i j) (> (occ (nth g i)) (occ (nth g j))))))
  (define anchor (first occupancy-order))
  (define chosen-color (mode (nth g (- (rows g) 1)) 1))
  (define (active i) (freq (nth g i) chosen-color))
  (define (denominator i) 1)
  (define (key i) (append (list (- (active i))) (list i)))
  (define ordered (sort indices (lambda (i j) (key<? (key i) (key j)))))
  (map (lambda (i) (nth g i)) ordered)))
